item.title: I Will Find You
item.description:
Platform: Netflix
First Air Date: 2026-06-18

Wrongfully imprisoned for murdering his own son, a father sets out on a desperate rescue mission after learning the boy may still be alive.

item.title: Lucky
item.description:
Platform: Apple TV+
First Air Date: 2026-07-14

When a multi-million-dollar heist goes sideways, con artist Lucky is forced to go on the run. Pursued by both the FBI and a ruthless crime boss, Lucky must fight for her life—and a way out.

item.title: Elite Force
item.description:
Platform: Netflix
First Air Date: 2026-07-22

After an unprecedented attack on his unit, a high-ranking officer set to leave the field leads a perilous mission that forces him to confront his past.

item.title: Soy Luna: Let's Roll Again
item.description:
Platform: Disney+
First Air Date: 2026-07-24

After an accident that sidelined her, Luna returns to her beloved Jam & Roller. Putting on her skates again won't be easy, especially when a hidden villain's plan starts to complicate her life. She'll also face a dilemma, torn between old flames. Amidst songs, adventures, and reunions with friends, Luna will have to overcome many obstacles to fulfill her dream.

item.title: Ride or Die
item.description:
Platform: Prime Video
First Air Date: 2026-07-15

Best friends Debbie and Judith are forced on the run when Debbie discovers Judith isn't a forensic accountant, she's an international assassin! With a mysterious figure chasing them, and Debbie's husband involved in something deeply corrupt, it's a race against time and a road trip across Europe to untangle the truth and stay alive.
